name: Get contacts dashboard summary
description: Call this when you need a high‑level overview of contact statistics for the Brevo dashboard, such as total contacts and recent activity. Use the detailed contacts list action instead when you need information about individual contacts.

last30DaysData.description: Number of contacts added or engaged in the last 30 days.

totalContacts.description: Total number of contacts in the account.

isOldCampaignFlowEnabled.description: Flag indicating whether the old campaign flow is enabled.

isFirstContact.description: Indicator (0/1) if this is the first contact in the account.
